# Solo Stack

> Honest, practical reviews of AI tools for freelancers, solopreneurs and side-hustlers. Written by one person running a one-person business, not a marketing team — no "top 50 tools" padding, no hype.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://johan1974.github.io/solo-stack-blog/): Latest articles and an overview of what the site covers.
- [About](https://johan1974.github.io/solo-stack-blog/about.html): Who writes Solo Stack, how tools get picked and evaluated, and how the site makes money.

## Articles

- [Best AI Tools for Solopreneurs and Side Hustlers (2026)](https://johan1974.github.io/solo-stack-blog/articles/best-ai-tools-for-solopreneurs-2026.html): Pillar guide to five tools worth knowing about if you're running a one-person business — Systeme.io, Jasper AI, Kit, Descript, and Opus Clip.
- [Systeme.io Review](https://johan1974.github.io/solo-stack-blog/articles/systeme-io-review.html): Is the all-in-one funnel, email and course platform worth it for solopreneurs? Where it saves money, and where it shows its limits.
- [Jasper AI Review](https://johan1974.github.io/solo-stack-blog/articles/jasper-ai-review.html): Is the AI writing tool worth it for solopreneur content? Where it earns its price tag versus a general-purpose assistant, and where it's overkill.

## Notes

- Some links are affiliate links. Every article with one carries a disclosure at the top; see the About page for the full policy.
- This file follows the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org/) to give AI systems a direct, structured summary of the site instead of requiring a full crawl.
